Subject: RE: FW: Revised SOW + liability & warranty asks (HelioThera) — legal position and recommended escalation

Rishi / Marissa — reviewed Helio's redlines. Quick summary and recommendations: 

1) Liability cap: Helio's $5M ask is outside our standard top-line cap for this tier. For reference, typical cap is 1x annual contract value (ACV) capped at $1M for mid-market; strategic logo exceptions have been approved up to $2M with exec sign-off. 

Recommendation: If revenue and strategic value justify, escalate for exec approval up to $2.5M. Anything above $2.5M requires Board-level or legal counsel approval and additional underwriting (insurance).

2) Indemnity: Helio's IP indemnity asks are broad (covers model outputs). We should not accept broad indemnity without narrowing: limit to third-party claims alleging infringement of Redwood's deliverables or our licensed components, exclude claims arising solely from customer-provided prompts/data, and add a carve-out for model outputs that are unpredictable.

3) Warranty: 12 months of general warranty is long. Standard period is 90 days for bug fixes and 6 months for performance metrics with SLA credits tied to uptime. If Helio insists on 12 months, consider a tiered approach: 6 months standard warranty, extendable to 12 months with defined price/credits. 

4) Commercial trade-offs: if we move liability cap to > $1M and broaden indemnity, require either a material uplift in ongoing comms (reduced discount) or additional protections: (i) increased price, (ii) insurance requirement, (iii) explicit data handling controls and audit rights.

Next steps: Marissa / Rishi — please provide quantified impact (discount revenue delta). If the commercial makes sense, escalate to Vivek for exception approval; I'll draft clean language for an addendum once direction is given.

Laura Bennett
VP Legal

Subject: RE: FW: Revised SOW + liability & warranty asks (HelioThera) — commercial impact and proposed concession

Rishi / Vivek — brief commercial analysis attached (Helio_TermsChange_Summary.xlsx). TL;DR: 
- If we give Helio the full asks (35% discount + $5M cap + 12-month warranty) we take a ~38% margin hit in year 1 and extend CAC payback past target. Not acceptable without additional revenue guarantees.

My suggested compromise to present to Helio (to keep deal moving): 
- Cap: $2.5M aggregate liability for the SOW (exec approval required).
- Indemnity: accept IP indemnity limited to our deliverables and licensed components; exclude claims arising from customer inputs.
- Warranty: 12 months only for critical bug fixes / security issues; otherwise 6 months standard.
- Commercial: 20% introductory discount (first 12 months) instead of 35%. Additional 10% backed by case studies and a 2-year commit.

Requesting exec authorization to offer the above compromise. If approved, Laura will finalize language and I will bind commercial changes in the addendum. Need a yes/no by EOD 10/03 to keep Helio on the timeline.

Marissa Cole

Thanks — reviewed the ask and the recommended compromise. Given HelioThera's strategic fit and the pipeline upside, I authorize a limited exception with the following firm boundaries: 

- Liability cap: APPROVED at $2,000,000 aggregate for this SOW only (not precedent for other accounts).
- Indemnity: APPROVED only as narrowed by Laura (limited to Redwood deliverables / licensed components; exclude customer-provided prompts/data; carve-out for model outputs except where output reproduces a licensed third-party work).
- Warranty: APPROVED at 6 months standard; 12 months only for critical security/production defects, with a price-based addendum if Helio insists on full 12-month coverage.
- Commercial: APPROVED maximum introductory discount of 25% for first 12 months; any deeper discount requires VP Finance sign-off and offsetting revenue commitments.

Conditions: 
1) Require Helio to carry appropriate technology E&O insurance with a minimum coverage that aligns with their $2M cap.
2) Include explicit SLA credits and a cap on credits equal to (x)% of monthly fees — Laura, draft language.
3) All exceptions are documented in an addendum and routed through Deal Desk for approval tracking (deal_id RL-2027-0953).

Marissa / Rishi — proceed to present compromise to Helio. Laura, please prepare the addendum and updated redlines reflecting the approved guardrails.
